title: Action Decoder
statement: For natural numbers $k,n$ and a Boolean list $x$, the decoder attempts to read, in order, an input-head movement, the actions on $k$ work tapes, an optional output symbol, and a state among $n+1$ possible states. On success it returns the resulting action, whose state set is $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$, together with the unconsumed Boolean list; otherwise it returns no result.
caveat: The component readers are not defined in the supplied context, so their precise encodings and failure conditions cannot be specified.
